label: SI-4(22)
title: Unauthorized Network Services

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Detect network services that have not been authorized or approved by {{ insert: param, si-04.22_odp.01 }} ; and

guidance: Unauthorized or unapproved network services include services in service-oriented architectures that lack organizational verification or validation and may therefore be unreliable or serve as malicious rogues for valid services.

params.label: authorization or approval processes
guidelines: authorization or approval processes for network services are defined;

params.label: personnel or roles
guidelines: personnel or roles to be alerted upon the detection of network services that have not been authorized or approved by authorization or approval processes is/are defined (if selected);
